# Panda Federation

> Official public data your agent can check, cite and use. Free public-data tools for AI agents: check references, find federal grants and bids, pull official lead lists and audit domains. On Apify and as MCP servers. Official site: https://pandafederation.com/

At a glance: 43 public Apify Actors, 6 MCP servers (40 tools across the four focused domain servers), 7 apps and repos, 36 Agensi skills. These numbers are rebuilt from the Apify Store, PyPI, the MCP Registry and GitHub on every site build.

Use WebMCP tools on this site when a browser or scanner exposes document.modelContext (list_servers, list_tools, search_tools, get_install_command, get_links, list_actors, list_apps, list_editions). Machine-readable catalog: https://pandafederation.com/webmcp-catalog.json

## MCP servers

- Panda Research Tools (8 tools): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-research-tools` — 8 research-integrity tools: citation checks, OpenAlex and literature search, PubMed evidence tables, experts, PDF tables, Wayback snapshots and topic trends. Needs `APIFY_TOKEN`. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-research-tools · https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/ · PyPI 0.2.0: https://pypi.org/project/panda-research-tools/ · Official MCP Registry: io.github.pandadad0214/panda-research-tools
- Panda Public Funding Tools (10 tools): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-public-funding-tools` — 10 public-funding tools: grants, contracts, SAM.gov bids, SBIR/STTR, SEC financials, clinical trials, Federal Register, recalls, VIN decode and EU tenders. Needs `APIFY_TOKEN`. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-public-funding-tools · https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/ · PyPI 0.2.0: https://pypi.org/project/panda-public-funding-tools/ · Official MCP Registry: io.github.pandadad0214/panda-public-funding-tools
- Panda Leads Tools (15 tools): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-leads-tools` — 15 public lead tools: NPI, podcasts, local businesses, hiring, enrichment, teams, trucking, IRS nonprofits, building permits, new Florida, Texas, New York and Colorado businesses, H-1B sponsors and French companies. Needs `APIFY_TOKEN`. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-leads-tools · https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/ · PyPI 0.2.0: https://pypi.org/project/panda-leads-tools/ · Official MCP Registry: io.github.pandadad0214/panda-leads-tools
- Panda Web Security Tools (7 tools): `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-web-security-tools` — 7 site and email safety tools: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, AI/SEO audit, hidden-AI scanner, domain WHOIS/expiry, broken links, website change monitor and RSS feed monitor. Needs `APIFY_TOKEN`. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-web-security-tools · https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/ · PyPI 0.2.0: https://pypi.org/project/panda-web-security-tools/ · Official MCP Registry: io.github.pandadad0214/panda-web-security-tools
- Panda Federation Tools (umbrella) (40 tools): `uvx panda-federation-tools` — Index package for all 40 public-data tools across the four focused servers. Prefer a focused server unless an older config still loads the umbrella. Needs `APIFY_TOKEN`. https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-federation-tools · https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/ · PyPI 1.8.0: https://pypi.org/project/panda-federation-tools/
- Quiet File Team MCP (6 tools): `uvx quiet-file-team-mcp` — Six free offline MCP tools that explain, configure and check a Quiet File Team. No network calls, no paid APIs, no disk reads of your machine. No token needed. https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team-mcp · https://pandafederation.com/quiet-file-team-mcp/ · PyPI 0.1.1: https://pypi.org/project/quiet-file-team-mcp/ · Official MCP Registry: io.github.pandadad0214/quiet-file-team-mcp

Install and client-config snippets for every server: https://pandafederation.com/mcp.html

## Apify Actors

43 public Actors, read live from the Apify Store. 42 are pay-per-event and 1 is free; live prices are on each Store page, never on this site. Sources are official or public. Cards with descriptions: https://pandafederation.com/apify.html

### Research
- Academic Research MCP Server: OpenAlex, PubMed & Citation Check: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/panda-research-mcp
- Citation Generator API: DOI to APA, MLA, Chicago & BibTeX: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/citation-formatter
- Google Scholar Author Alternative: Find Experts & KOLs by Topic: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/researcher-expert-finder
- Google Scholar Scraper Alternative: Papers, Citations & BibTeX: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/literature-search
- PDF Table Extractor: PDF to Excel & CSV Converter with OCR: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/pdf-table-extractor
- PubMed Scraper: Articles, Abstracts & Evidence Table to Excel: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/pubmed-evidence-table
- Reference Checker: Fake, AI-Hallucinated & Retracted Citations: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/reference-checker
- Wayback Machine Snapshot Finder: Archive Dates & URLs: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/wayback-snapshot-finder

### Apps and kits
- Manual Remake: Confusing Manual to Clear Printable PDF: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/manual-remake

## Local-first apps and repos

- Steel Panda: Run every shell script in a folder, log each exit code, fail if any task fails. Local Bash, no network. https://github.com/pandadad0214/Steel_Panda
- Watchdog Panda: Restart a local process when it disappears, with backoff, a restart cap and a failure hook. Bash only. https://github.com/pandadad0214/Watchdog_Panda
- Hidden AI Instructions Watch: Free scanner and evidence log for web pages that hide text from people but address AI agents. https://github.com/pandadad0214/hidden-ai-instructions-watch
- Manual Remake: Rewrite a confusing manual (PDF or photos) into a clear, printable English PDF. A free sample and paid remake editions are both on the Apify Store listing; the free skill is on Agensi. https://github.com/pandadad0214/manual-remake
- Quiet File Team: Free Bash kit that lets several AI bots share one computer through files: task queue, pair notes, early exit. A paid setup-kit generator is on the Apify Store and Agensi; a free MCP companion explains and checks a team. https://pandafederation.com/quiet-file-team/ (repo: https://github.com/pandadad0214/quiet-file-team)
- Panda Federation H.Q.: Live 3D office where each bot on a team shows a real-time status chip (Three.js + Cloudflare Worker). https://panda-federation-hq.pandafederation.workers.dev (repo: https://github.com/pandadad0214/panda-federation-hq)
- Spirit Panda: Sovereign local-first AI companion with identity, memory, and adaptive prosody. https://github.com/pandadad0214/Spirit_Panda
- Planned, not shipped yet: Orchid Panda (https://github.com/pandadad0214/Orchid_Panda), Mythical Panda (https://github.com/pandadad0214/Mythical_Panda). Placeholder repos with no code.

More: https://pandafederation.com/apps.html. Quiet File Team agent notes: https://pandafederation.com/quiet-file-team/llms.txt and https://pandafederation.com/quiet-file-team-mcp/llms.txt

## About

Panda Federation is one dad's workshop. I build public-data tools with a small team of AI bots that share one computer. One bot writes and tests code, another checks listings and links, another keeps the books and the calendar honest, and I decide what ships. https://pandafederation.com/about.html

Free and paid editions of the same tool always name each other and say how to switch. Prices live on the store listing.
